topic: Medeiros-2022-School-based food and nutrition education interventions for adolescent food consumption
final_message:
The one-line PubMed query is saved to [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-9c6e3b4b8b2f6f5e/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T091850Z/final_strategy.txt). The search uses education, adolescent/student, and school-setting concepts, with a publication-date limit through 2017-12-14. It does not require a separate food-consumption outcome term, to reduce the chance of missing eligible studies.

The CLI reported 23,453 results, but its date-limited samples included records published after the cutoff. I documented this inconsistency and the MeSH checks, search decisions, and limitations in the [run report](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-9c6e3b4b8b2f6f5e/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T091850Z/work/strategy_report.md). Treat the count cautiously and recheck the date limit in PubMed. The strategy remains a draft for peer review by a second information specialist.
